- To make 1 white wool, we need 4 string.
- To make 4 string, we need 4 cobblestone and 4 sticks.

- Therefore, we have 6 white carpets and 3 white carpets = 9 white carpets, which is enough to make 1 cyan carpet.
- We also have 2 cyan dyes.

8. Use 1 blue dye and 1 green dye to make 2 cyan dyes.
